spells.name: Như Lai Thần Chưởng
spells.how: Một chưởng đẩy ra, bàn tay Phật vàng khổng lồ lao tới đánh bật địch.
spells.vis: a giant upright golden Buddha palm made of light charging forward
spells.guide: frames 1-4: the palm flying to the RIGHT (seamless loop, centered); frames 5-8: a burst of golden light with a lotus-shaped shockwave
spells.pose_txt: a deep horse-stance lunge, one open palm thrust straight forward with full force, the other hand held vertically at the chest in prayer

spells.name: Kim Chung Tráo
spells.how: Một chiếc chuông vàng úp xuống bao lấy thân, đao thương bất nhập.
spells.vis: a giant translucent golden temple bell covering the caster, with glowing sanskrit runes around its rim
spells.guide: standing on the bottom of the cell, semi-transparent: frames 1-3 the bell coming down; frames 4-6 holding with runes glowing; frames 7-8 fading
spells.pose_txt: a firm stance with palms pressed together in prayer, the body tensed like iron

spells.name: La Hán Quyền
spells.how: Lướt tới trước mặt địch tung chuỗi quyền dồn dập 4 đòn.
spells.vis: a flurry of overlapping golden fist strikes
spells.guide: centered: frame 1 empty; frames 2-5 more and more glowing fists appear, overlapping; frames 6-8 fading
spells.pose_txt: a rapid flurry of straight punches with both fists, leaning forward

spells.name: Phật Thủ Giáng Thế
spells.how: Bàn tay Phật khổng lồ từ trời úp xuống đè bẹp địch, rung chuyển cả sân.
spells.vis: a giant golden Buddha hand slamming down palm-first from the sky
spells.guide: frames 1-4: the giant hand coming down from the TOP of the cell; frames 5-8: pressed onto the bottom of the cell with a golden shockwave, then fading
spells.pose_txt: one arm raised straight up with the palm open, then swung down hard, the other hand in prayer

spells.name: Liên Hoa Tịnh Toạ
spells.how: Ngồi kiết già trên đài sen vàng, tịnh tâm hồi máu.
spells.vis: a blooming pink-gold lotus flower with a round golden halo above
spells.guide: the lotus on the bottom of the cell, the halo in the middle: frames 1-3 blooming; frames 4-6 glowing; frames 7-8 fading
spells.pose_txt: sitting down cross-legged in lotus meditation with hands resting in the lap, eyes closed

spells.name: Lục Tự Chân Ngôn
spells.how: Tụng chân ngôn, ba chữ phạn vàng bay ra ba tầng đánh vào địch.
spells.effect: Mỗi chữ trúng xoá 1 hiệu ứng tốt của địch
spells.vis: a glowing golden sanskrit syllable inside a ring of light
spells.guide: frames 1-4: the syllable flying to the RIGHT (seamless loop, centered); frames 5-8: dissolving into golden motes
spells.pose_txt: one hand raised in a mudra gesture beside the face, chanting, prayer beads swinging in the other hand

spells.name: Sư Tử Hống
spells.how: Gầm lên một tiếng, sóng âm vàng dồn tới, đẩy lùi địch và ngắt phép.
spells.effect: Ngắt phép đang niệm, đẩy lùi nhẹ
spells.vis: golden curved sound waves pushing outward horizontally
spells.guide: every cell is ONE horizontal segment of the sound waves entering at the exact middle of the left edge and leaving at the exact middle of the right edge (tileable); frames 1-6 pulsing; frames 7-8 thinning
spells.pose_txt: crouching and roaring with the mouth wide open, arms thrown back, a lion-roar shout

spells.name: Thiếu Lâm Côn Pháp
spells.how: Ném cây côn xoay tròn bay tới đánh địch rồi quay về tay, trúng 2 lần.
spells.vis: a wooden shaolin staff with brass caps spinning
spells.guide: all 8 frames: the staff spinning in place, centered (seamless loop)
spells.pose_txt: spinning a long wooden staff overhead, then hurling it forward
